summary: Direct recruitment quota for judicial services; Fast Track Court judge absorption affecting advertised vacancies; 14 general posts initially advertised but 5 absorbed into Fast Track vacancies as per Brij Mohan Lal directions; additional 4 posts added later, totaling 13 appointments; merit position 14 ineligible; arbitrariness challenge rejected; appointment rights conditional on genuine vacancy availability despite merit rank.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 142 of the Constitution of India
Shankarsan Dash v. Union of India (1991) 3 SCC 47
Brij Mohan Lal (1) v. Union of India (2002) 2 SCC 1
Brij Mohan Lal (2) v. Union of India (2012) 6 SCC 502
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding non-appointment sustained.
